brief: Production (FNC registered) in October 2026: 1.11m bags, -8% on a year ago and -1% against the 5-year average for the month. Last 12 months: 12.56m bags (a year earlier 14.74m; three months ago 12.73m).
Exports in September 2026: 1.18m bags, +9% on a year ago and +22% against the 5-year average. Last 12 months: 11.79m bags (a year earlier 13.34m).
Washed-arabica supply from Colombia is smaller than a year ago, and the 12-month production total is still falling over the last three months.

FNC put the Colombian differential at 71.5¢/lb over New York in October 2026; the KC contract pays only +10¢ for Colombian coffee, so a delivered lot gives up about 61¢/lb against selling it in the physical market. Colombian coffee is not expected on the exchange while that gap lasts. ICE certified stock held 250 bags of Colombian coffee on 2026-11-16 (total 186,414).
Internal reference price 2.115m COP per carga on 2026-11-17 = 307.1¢/lb green at 3,356 COP/US$, +25.7¢ against KC front (281.4¢). A year earlier it was 2.860m COP.
